releases.name: v0.3.19 — hotfix: openqq TDZ + supervisor lease
releases.body:
# OpenCode QQ Bot v0.3.19 — hotfix

Two production-affecting fixes; upgrade recommended for anyone on 0.3.16-0.3.18.

## `bin/openqq.js` TDZ — every `openqq` subcommand crashed on launch

`bin/openqq.js` read `argv[0]` in the watchdog/restart/service branches before `const argv` was declared at line 30. Under ESM this is a temporal-dead-zone `ReferenceError` at module evaluation, so **`openqq notify`, `openqq restart`, `openqq service install|status|uninstall`, `openqq watchdog --once`, and bare `openqq` all failed on 0.3.16, 0.3.17, and 0.3.18**. The plugin flavor was unaffected (the plugin spawns `dist/openqq-bot.js` directly).

- Fix: declaration moved ahead of first use; duplicate removed.
- Regression guard: new `bin-smoke-cases.ts` runs the shim (`notify --dry-run`) and asserts exit=0 with no `ReferenceError` — the shim lives outside the tsc/build chains, so this class of bug previously escaped CI. verify 70/70 green.
- Workaround if you cannot upgrade yet: call the dist entries directly — `node <pkg>/dist/notify-cli.js`, `node <pkg>/dist/openqq-watchdog.js --once`, `node <pkg>/dist/openqq-cli.js restart`, `node <pkg>/dist/openqq-bot.js`.

## Supervisor lease — `--once` patrols self-deferred (5min → 10min)

The lease was judged by pid. Every `--once` run is a new pid, so the service channel deferred to its own previous lease ("not me"), and a 5-minute scheduled patrol actually ran every 10 minutes.

New model (design.md §3.9.1): fixed **channel priority `service > plugin`**, freshness by **timestamp only**, **pid demoted to a diagnostics field**. `--once` renews across pid churn; plugin keeps same-channel different-pid mutex for concurrent engine loads; service recovery takes the lease back immediately. 13 lease cases cover pid churn, incumbent deferral, expiry takeover, and recovery.

## Upgrade

```bash
opencode plugin add @linjz/opencode-qqbot@latest
openqq restart   # optional, only if you want the new bundle active immediately (idle, non-force)
```

releases.name: v0.3.18 — cockpit, native file sending, honest resumption
releases.body:
# OpenCode QQ Bot v0.3.18

Two weeks of hardening since v0.3.17 — driven by production incidents, owner reviews, and a public design discussion with the Open Agent API author.

## Highlights

**`qq_send_file` — AI sends files natively**
The AI sends local files/images to QQ through a first-class tool with a JSON-Schema contract. Failures return precise structured errors (allowlist roots listed so the model can self-correct); identical files auto-dedupe. The old `QQ_SEND_FILE:` text marker survives as a fallback. Root cause it fixes: the marker syntax was never injected into prompts, so models guessed — and needed several attempts.

**System-level channel instructions**
QQ rendering/format rules now arrive as session instructions (`<context key="qq">`) instead of being appended to prompt text. Desktop session history stays clean; the rule follows the session, keyed by channel.

**Status cockpit**
`/status` is now the single dashboard — server/session/model/agent/observation/mirror/queue/logs. `/status watch on|off` and `/status mirror on|off` are the only switches; standalone `/watch` `/mirror` retired.

**Honest dead-turn resumption**
A dead background turn is judged by three signals (last-activity threshold + running-tool grace window + turn-unterminated), aborted with the outcome recorded (rationale/action/consequence), and resumed with a targeted dedupe hint naming the in-flight tool. When the abort is unconfirmed, the model must verify processes and side effects before redoing any write. Shaped by [Discussion #3](https://github.com/linjz3376/opencode-qqbot/discussions/3) with jiangxingfan1-coder.

**Busy-time steer by default**
Messages arriving mid-turn merge into the running turn (official steer semantics). `/queue <text>` enqueues explicitly; `QQ_BUSY_DEFAULT=queue` restores classic FIFO.

## Engineering

69 test suites on a parallel runner (was serial); state-store hardening (test guard, ghost-mapping eviction, load validation); `deploy/` retired; design-doc reconciliation batch; macOS/Linux desktop automation playbooks (desk-research level).

## Upgrade

```bash
opencode plugin add @linjz/opencode-qqbot@latest   # plugin flavor
openqq restart                                     # activate (idle, batched)
```

---

Known P3 (cosmetic, registered): permission-card save line truncates to 121 visible chars vs the ≤120 criterion — rationale and both fix paths documented in-code at `formatPermissionPrompt`.

releases.name: v0.3.17 — 会话修正三件套 + 官方命令全对齐
releases.body:
﻿## v0.3.17 — Session-correction suite, official command alignment, production hardening

**Official OpenCode alignment (same engine-side implementation as desktop)**
- /undo + /amend: official snapshots semantics (revert stage→commit, file restore, prompt回盒)
- /goal /compact /redo /btw: engine command passthrough — goal mode (idle judge, 50-round cap) works from QQ
- /models /agents plural names; busy-time default = steer (official TUI "Enter steers"), `QQ_BUSY_DEFAULT=queue` opt-out; /queue <text> explicit enqueue; /amend explicit steer

**Learning absorption (P0 sources)**
- Clickable command tags (`<qqbot-cmd-input>`) in recovery notices + notices copy catalog
- Outbound scaffolding sanitize (thinking/system-reminder strips)
- Quick-disconnect storm guard (5 quick closes / 60s -> 5min cooldown)
- STT fallback chain (QQ ASR -> external OpenAI-compatible endpoint via QQ_STT_*)
- Cron reminders via QQBOT_PAYLOAD marker (dual-end: QQ-dispatched and desktop/mirror turns)
- Approval cards show the rule "always allow" will save; local file path normalization (file://, ~, URL-decode)

**Platform & ops**
- config.json layering (~/.openqq/config.json, env > .env > config.json > defaults) — official-style json=behavior/env=secrets
- Mirror third attribution bucket: goal continuation rounds labeled "🎯 目标续跑摘要"
- Kill-audit trail matured (kills.log real entries); test isolation for audit logs
- Full env reference (44 documented vars), bilingual README (EN default + zh-CN)

59 test suites green. Install: `opencode plugin add @linjz/opencode-qqbot`

releases.name: v0.3.16：六笔修复全实弹批次
releases.body:
﻿QQBot 多角色单进程六笔缺陷修复全实弹批次（v36→v43，11-18/11-19 二十四小时战役）

- P6 镜像身份守卫：SSE 重放事件穿透时序锁致 QQ 直答回合重复收摘要 → promptId 来源身份核对（owner 拍板：判信息来源不依赖时序）
- P8 SSE 静默看门狗：对端 FIN/RST 部分路径下 body 迭代器不抛错 → 120s 零字节判死走既有指数退避（QQ_SSE_SILENCE_MS 可覆盖；dropsse 实弹重连 9/9）
- P9 Retry-After 退避：429 注入原固定节奏 → client 透出 [retry-after:N] 标记，就绪环路按暗示值退避（boot 实证）
- P10 看门狗双信号守卫：CLI/引导器 spawn 被心跳文件判定误杀 → 锁 mtime（instance-lock 10s 第二心跳）新鲜时不杀（watchdog-cases +4 例）
- P11 req per-call 超时：引擎挂起时裸 fetch 无限等致 deadline 判定不可达 → AbortSignal.timeout 30s + 轮询迭代容错（挂死 33min 回合复验恢复）
- P12 事件洪峰队列化：SSE 洪峰饿死事件循环（假掉线 17min 实证）→ 读循环入队+批量让出+背压丢弃（50k 洪峰心跳 293/300 实弹，新挂 47 套件链第 47 套）
- notify outbox 按角色分文件（多角色改造补漏）

测试：tsc + 47 套件全绿；六笔修复各附实弹验证证据。
工程：test/（单测）/tests/（验收产物）双目录语义落定，二者均不入 git。

releases.name: OpenCode QQ Bot 0.3.15 - notify channel + review fixes
releases.body:
﻿## OpenCode QQ Bot 0.3.15 - notify channel + code-review fixes

- New: **openqq notify** external enqueue channel (external proposal Part1 adopted). cron / CI / any process can push results to QQ without session binding:

opencode run ... --auto | openqq notify --max-chars 1200

CLI only enqueues (~/.openqq/outbox.json, file-locked atomic writes, idempotent by --id, TTL 24h, fail-closed recipients); the bot consumes and delivers through the existing delivery stack (quota, passive-to-active fallback, chunking, dedup).

- Fixed: module-load env capture family - QQ_SANDBOX / OPENCODE_TURN_TIMEOUT_MINUTES / QQ_DELIVERY_DEDUPE_FILE now read lazily, so ~/.openqq/.env works in published builds without shell exports
- Fixed: rejected not-allowlisted users now log their openid (first-config dead-end)
- Fixed: recovery anchors - attachment-only messages prefer arrival-time anchor; probe length 50 -> 100
- UX: same-text duplicate reply now includes an in-flight content digest
- Docs: README platform notes + capability parity matrix; form failure copy now points to the re-ask loop

Install: opencode plugin add @linjz/opencode-qqbot | npm i -g @linjz/opencode-qqbot
Repo: https://github.com/linjz3376/opencode-qqbot (Chinese README, review playbook in docs/)
